text:
incident-bot: Pager: SLO alert triggered - inference-gateway 5xx spike in us-west-2 (5m avg 9.2%). Incident ID INC-20260315-1432. Notifying on-call.

alice.eng: taking first pass, pulling traces and logs from gateway + model-runners.

bob.sre: i'm on call, joining the debug. any obvious patterns?

alice.eng: prometheus shows a sudden jump in kernel paging and OOM kills on nodes backing model-runner pool. Gateway 502/504 correlate with worker restarts. grabbing `dmesg` snippet now.

alice.eng: ```
[ 1234.567890] Out of memory: Killed process 4321 (model-runner) total-vm:12G, anon-rss:10G
[ 1234.568200] model-runner invoked oom-killer, stack trace: 
#0 0x7f... segfault at 0x0
```

carla-ml: seeing extremely long-token sessions from a small subset of customers causing KV cache growth; some requests are 60k tokens. runner isn't trimming prefixes.

bob.sre: confirmed eviction loops in node logs -> disk thrash, iostat high, latency skyrockets -> gateway times out after backend stop responding.

alice.eng: immediate mitigation idea: enable cross-region fallback to eu-west-1 to offload new traffic and reduce pressure on us-west-2, and reduce KV cache TTL to stop unbounded growth. starting failover for non-enterprise routes now.

oncall-bot: Cross-region failover initiated by alice.eng at 3132131480. Routing policy: new requests -> eu-west-1 (graceful shift).

emma-platform: spinning up warm pool in eu-west-1 with quantized fallback models v1qb (lower mem). Scaling target +150 replicas.

dan-cs: CS reporting ~12 customers impacted with 502s, some on enterprise plans. Is there any ETA for customer-facing mitigation?

alice.eng: ETA ~8-12 minutes to finish traffic shift and get quantized runners in front. posting status to status.redwoodai.com.

alice.eng: running a quick config change to reduce KV cache retention: `redwoodctl config set kvcache.retention_seconds=300 --scope=model-runner`

bob.sre: cordoning affected nodes and draining pods: `kubectl cordon inference-node-42 && kubectl drain inference-node-42 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

carla-ml: also rolling a hotfix build that trims streaming session cache after 10k tokens. pushing image `model-runner:2026-03-15-kvfix` to canary pool.

oncall-bot: Canary deploy started at 3132131560 to 5% of traffic in eu-west-1.

bob.sre: after drain and failover, kernel paging and iowait dropping on drained nodes. observed fewer OOM kills. watching for crash recurrence.

emma-platform: scaling finished; quantized fallback healthy, 200rps capacity online in eu-west-1.

dan-cs: passed updates to CS channel and to affected customers with temporary workaround instructions.

alice.eng: observed request latency drop from 3.4s -> 350ms for eu-west routed traffic, 5xx rate in us-west-2 down from 9% -> 1.2%. global 5xx now 0.9%.

carla-ml: initial hypothesis: unbounded KV cache growth for extremely long streaming sessions triggers memory exhaustion and segfaults in model-runner native layer. Patch to trim cache and TTL change should prevent recurrence; follow-up: add telemetry to track per-session token count and cache size.

bob.sre: creating paged remediation runbook entry and adding kernel OOM guardrails to daemonset config (oom_score_adj, pids limit).

oncall-bot: Incident severity set to P1 at 3132131620.

alice.eng: handing off active monitoring to emma-platform in 10m. Notes: root cause suspected KV cache growth + long prompts; mitigations applied: cross-region fallback, quantized model fallback, reduced TTL, rolling restart/hotfix. Will write RCA draft once stable.

emma-platform: ack. i'll take watch and escalate if error rate rises above 2% again. will post final update when stable for 30m.

dan-cs: thanks team. CS will keep customers updated and follow up on SLA impacts.

oncall-bot: last check-in 3132131745 - overall 5xx under 1% for last 5m.

alice.eng: closing active hot-mitigation window, leaving incident open for RCA and postmortem. handoff complete to emma-platform.

emma-platform: I'll assemble timeline and link to postmortem doc (will create at /docs/incidents/INC-20260315-1432-rca).

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260315-1432 acknowledged, handoff recorded.
